title: Thinking in chords and changes
summary: Questions on whether Hall thinks of arpeggios and chords; he knows the changes and studied chord exercise books.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: What to think while improvising: wrong notes and being in the moment

blocks.x: I was wondering in your cards, that is your broken cards, your arpeggios, like say a part that goes, you're going to play, are you thinking I'm going to use the C card, now I go to B flat, now I go to G, now I go to B flat? Yeah. Are you thinking, do you think those in your mind?
Yeah, yeah, but you know the changes. Yeah, usually if you're going to, if you're going to play a tune and you're going to play a hard course, you've got to know the changes.
Do you actually think of it or you just sort of know it by instinct without...

But instinct, yeah, if you're used to the tune, you know what makes it. A lot of time, you may make something you think is going one place and you go, that's what I say about reading music, see. So a lot of time, if you don't know the tune, of course if you know the tune, it's a different thing.
I just wondered if you're ever conscious now, I'm playing the B flat part, I'm going to do, and then you change, now I've got to go to E flat.
Yeah. You actually think of those things in your mind, sometimes when you play. Yeah, sometimes you go to E minor, you may go to E, you know what I mean?
It's changing the chord. Did you ever study those chords? You set the books and things on?

Yeah, oh yeah, that's what I bought that exercise book from. Do you remember what the book that was? No, I've got a couple of, I still have them, a couple of messages at home, they call them messages, exercise book. Five and any chord? Yeah, and because another thing that's good about it, you study those chords and you notice the principal notes in the chord, and if somebody says, well listen, what chord is that on the piano? And he says, well that's certain such a chord on the piano, well if you know the chord, you know the notes, you know what I mean, you know what note consists of that chord, you got it. Sure. Yeah.
That all takes probably a bit of study, at least it does a vibe.
